rule:
Each voice's own preview (founder, 2026-10-17): "Hear <name>" no longer
plays a Circle's activity but the voice introducing itself. Founder-chosen
line, the voice's name being the only difference:
  "Hi, I’m <Name>. I’ll tell you when each part of your Circle begins, so
   you can put the screen down."
(lib/features/personal_circle/domain/spoken_cues.dart `spokenPreviewFor`).

1. Generation: exact voice ID, eleven_multilingual_v2, the frozen settings,
   seed 30, mp3_44100_128; one request per voice -> previews/raw/<id>.mp3,
   previews/generation_log.json. Skips a take already on disk.
2. Raw QA (the normal checks): provenance, ASR against the script,
   onset/ending, sample clipping, inner stalls, the frozen pause-bed check,
   timbre against the voice's own shipping takes (diagnostic).
3. Master by the frozen production rule with the voice's FROZEN median and
   voice-wide gain (mastering_report.json), exactly as the approved
   corrections were: the other 168 clips are not touched. Written to
   assets/audio/guidance/<id>/preview_<fingerprint>.m4a.
4. previews/listen/all_four_previews.m4a and previews/preview_qa.json.
Usage: python preview_production.py <repo>   (PYTHONPATH: the validation tools)
